searchText: Hello, what will happen if geth synchronization fails? <@548344914572869636> Hi, I run https://github.com/jimmygchen/eip4844-devnet on the server and the synchronization keeps failing. Is there something wrong with the configuration? We are running it for blobscan without any issue. Make sure your ports are open and the hard drive is fast enough
